system.description: Starting at 14th level, your strikes are no longer just attacks, but instead declarations of supremacy. With a single, perfectly timed blow, you bring the full weight of your skill, power, and fury to bear, cutting through defenses with ruthless finality and should the battle demand it, you’ll do it again and again. When you score a critical hit, you can choose to maximize your attacks damage without doubling the dice pool, instead of rolling twice the damage dice pool. If you do, you also double your ability modifier as well (Ex. 4d10 +5, becomes 40+10, instead of 8d10+5).
